reviewedRevision: 9f17aa2 plus the depth pass in this commit
process: Not level-based (one continuous tower), so no retrofit. One independent review round passed it for correctness but raised two MEDIUM design findings (a flat, short tower and misleading touch labels). They were fixed and verified by re-running the reviewer's own pilot, blind, physics and touch scripts, one clean-worktree run and the browser check, without a second review round.
independentProbes: On the final files the reviewer's reaction-limited pilot (public state, 0.25 s and 0.35 s delay) reached the summit 6 of 6 times at each delay, now taking 45-163 s with up to 3 falls instead of the earlier 21-26 s; its stamina and lamp ran out on the way, so both meters matter. Blind play (idle, mash, random keys and 27 timed hold, alternate and grip patterns) won 0 of 68 and got no higher than ledge 5 of 18. The jump apex is 65.6 px at 60, 120 and 240 Hz, 40 hostile-input fuzz runs found no violation or double end, a scripted pattern gave the same outcome at 30, 60 and 120 Hz, and an idle run ends once when the lamp runs out.

findings.observation: Review finding: ledges 0-13 repeated the same hop, the meters never mattered, every run was identical and a competent climb took about 25 s. The tower now ramps through three sections with narrower ledges and wider gaps, faster and wider swaying decks, four required rail climbs (100-215 px), climbing that drains grip and lamp fuel that burns faster higher up with no brazier on the last stretch, and seeded variation in ledge edges and deck motion. Situation-aware hints are drawn on the canvas. A corner-touch landing that froze the simulation was also fixed, with a regression test.

Review finding: the touch buttons read 'Climb + Grip' but did not grip. They now read 'Climb ↑' and 'Climb ↓' (上爬↑ / 下爬↓), and the EN and ZH help explains holding Grip with one thumb and Climb with the other.

openNotes: The final stretch from the last brazier to the summit is harsh: the pilot sometimes lost lives to the lamp there.
The fourth rail (215 px) needs a nearly full grip bar.
Off the default rate the pilot is less steady (4 of 6 at 30 Hz with a 0.35 s delay); the host always steps at 1/120 s.

browser.method: Official Claude in Chrome extension, local server; real clicks on Start and the touch buttons, synthetic in-page keys; only DOM text and the canvas were read.
observed: English: Start opened section 1/3 (Moonlit Atrium) with Grip and Lamp meters, the hint 'Run to an edge, then jump across. Rest at the braziers.' drawn under the header, and the player and first ledges unobscured.
English 390 px phone frame (388 px inner, no horizontal overflow): touch buttons Left, Right, Climb ↑, Climb ↓, Jump, Hold Grip and Relight; Right then Jump launched the climber.
Not covered in the browser: reaching the summit and a loss; the reviewer's pilot, idle and fuzz runs cover them.
